# Ontario Move-Out Checklist for a One-Bedroom Apartment

Use this as a practical move-out plan for a renter in Ontario leaving on **2026-03-31**. It is designed to reduce disputes about cleaning, pet-related wear, and repairs, and to support a clear request for the return of any deposit.

## Move-Out Inspection and Deposit Protection Checklist

| Item | What to do | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Notice and date | Confirm your move-out date in writing and keep a copy | Prevents confusion about possession and access |
| Lease review | Check the lease for cleaning, keys, parking, and pet clauses | Helps you match the landlord’s expectations |
| Damage deposit | Confirm what the deposit was called and how it was paid | In Ontario, deposit handling can depend on the type of deposit |
| Utilities | Arrange final meter readings and end dates | Avoids later billing disputes |
| Cleaning | Return the unit to a clean, broom-swept condition unless your lease says otherwise | Reduces claims for cleaning charges |
| Repairs | Fix small damage you caused if reasonable; do not attempt major repairs without approval | Avoids accidental worsening of issues |
| Pet areas | Remove pet hair, odours, stains, and marks; clean vents, baseboards, and hidden corners | Pet-related residue is a common dispute point |
| Keys and access devices | Return all keys, fobs, garage openers, mailbox keys, and parking passes | Missing items can trigger charges |
| Inspection | Request a joint move-out inspection and walk through the unit together | Creates a shared record of condition |
| Written confirmation | Ask for a dated written note of any issues found | Makes later disagreements easier to resolve |

## Move-Out Inspection Checklist

### Living Room and Bedroom
- Vacuum and mop floors
- Remove nail holes only if permitted; patch small holes neatly
- Wipe walls, switches, baseboards, window sills, and closet shelves
- Check for scuffs, scratches, and furniture marks
- Remove all personal items and garbage

### Kitchen
- Clean inside and outside of fridge, stove, oven, microwave, and cupboards
- Wipe backsplash, counters, sink, faucet, and handles
- Clean grease buildup and crumbs
- Remove food, containers, and expired items
- Defrost and clean freezer if needed

### Bathroom
- Scrub toilet, tub, shower, sink, mirror, and fixtures
- Remove soap scum, mildew, and hair
- Clean fan cover, edges, and behind the toilet
- Check for leaks, loose hardware, or cracked caulking

### Entry, Hallway, and Storage
- Vacuum or mop floors
- Clean closet shelves and doors
- Remove scuffs near the entrance
- Check light fixtures and replace burned-out bulbs if required by lease

### Pet-Related Cleaning
- Vacuum carpets, rugs, furniture edges, and corners thoroughly
- Clean pet hair from vents, baseboards, and under appliances
- Remove odours with proper cleaning rather than masking sprays
- Check for scratches on doors, trim, and screens
- Remove litter, food bowls, toys, and pet supplies

## Photos and Records to Capture

### Photograph before you leave
- Every room from each corner
- Floors, walls, ceilings, windows, and blinds
- Kitchen appliances inside and out
- Bathroom fixtures and caulking
- Closets, storage areas, and entryway
- Any existing damage you are not responsible for
- Pet-related areas, including scratches, stains, or cleaned spots
- The final condition of the unit after cleaning
- All returned keys, fobs, passes, and openers laid out together
- Final utility meter readings, if accessible

### Save as proof
- Lease agreement and any move-out instructions
- Emails or text messages about cleaning, repairs, or inspection
- Photos with date stamps if available
- A list of items returned to the landlord
- Notes from the move-out walkthrough
- Receipt for professional cleaning or repairs, if you used them

## Polite Deposit Return Message

Subject: Move-Out Confirmation and Deposit Return Request

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing to confirm that I moved out of **[unit address]** on **2026-03-31** and returned all keys and access devices as agreed.

I completed the cleaning and final walkthrough preparation, and I would appreciate a written confirmation of the unit’s condition. If there are any concerns, please let me know in writing with supporting details and photos.

Please also confirm the process and timeline for returning my deposit of **[deposit amount]**. I would be grateful if you could send the refund by **[preferred date]** to **[payment method or mailing address]**.

Thank you for your time and cooperation. I appreciate your help in closing out the tenancy smoothly.

Kind regards,
[Your full name]
[Phone number]
[Email address]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Save Checklist] <https://www.ontario.ca/page/renting-ontario-your-rights-and-responsibilities>
Action: [Button: Review Rights] <https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/>

- Landlord and Tenant Board: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
- Tribunals Ontario contact page: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/contact/
